pages.heading: A quiet world
pages.body:
The Overworld is sheltered by the Stillness. Live Bloom cannot normally take hold here. Your home needs neither liberation nor fuel to remain sheltered.

Look for small pale, cold traces on natural ground. Harvest this dormant tissue for flakes. It does not spread or infect. Newly explored Overworld terrain contains these traces; colonies whose hearts are gone leave the same dormant material.

A one-time search places a starter trace on suitable natural land within 128 blocks of world spawn and records its location on your first visit. An ocean spawn may have no suitable ground; ordinary traces still generate farther afield.

pages.heading: From traces to instruments
pages.body:
A book and a dormant flake make this journal. The assay kit also uses a raw flake rather than active essence. Neither needs a working machine.

Four flakes make a Dormant Knot. Build a Stillness Resonator around that knot using iron, copper and redstone, then build an Essence Condenser from ordinary materials. Place them adjacent. The sheltered knot supplies twenty Resonance per tick without burning flakes. A single flake and 4000 Resonance become one essence in ten seconds. Other FE generators can supply the condenser instead.

pages.heading: Your first deployment
pages.body:
Make the terminal using refined essence, then complete Field Survey to open remote deployments. You do not need to defeat an Overworld boss to leave home.

The first survey is practice with routes, checkpoints and extraction. The hostile frontier is elsewhere. Other dimensions still require preparation, repeated successful expeditions and their own bound guardian to become safe outposts.

The terminal needs glass rather than amethyst. Complete Field Survey to learn checkpoints, then Trace Recovery to learn carrying bound cargo back to extraction. Together these establish the home campaign and open Deep Salvage; repeating Survey is unnecessary.

bloom.title: II. The Bloom
bloom.unlock_hint: Approach an ember-lit assimilation heart within sixteen blocks. The journal records contact, even if you have not crafted it yet.

pages.heading: A fire under bark
pages.body:
The pale traces at home are the quiet remains of something held in suspension. Elsewhere the same material can carry an ember-lit heartbeat.

Living colonies spread from assimilation hearts. Break the heart to stop its colony: attached tissue becomes dormant while preserving its shape. Detached tissue yields dormant flakes rather than finished essence. Cold traces do not spread or infect.

The approved pale and amber material marks the same organism in both states; a living heartbeat makes the difference.

pages.heading: Work from the edge
pages.body:
Harvest attached tissue for raw flakes. Recover a heart if you want to build field instruments. Growth lost with its support yields no harvest.

Infection requires physical contact with living Bloom tissue or an infected body. Merely standing nearby is safe. Leave contact to let early exposure subside.

A Disruption Charm, held in the offhand or worn in a Curios charm slot, blocks new infection. String, amethyst, copper and essence make one. It does not cure an infection already established. Infected creatures keep their bodies but share threats and move as one unsettled mind.

This is not proof the Bloom was born here. Only proof it has learned to live here.

essence.title: III. What remains
essence.unlock_hint: Collect a dormant flake or a sample of refined assimilation essence.

pages.heading: Held change
pages.body:
A dormant knot wants to resume a heartbeat. The Stillness holds it short of that movement. A resonator harvests the tension as Resonance.

Resonance uses the standard FE connection: compatible generators, storage and cables can exchange it directly. It is not another incompatible power network.

The Stillness Resonator draws twenty Resonance per tick from sheltered or liberated ground. Nearby resonators within six blocks share that local field. Give them space. Collection is safe and never weakens home’s protection.

pages.heading: Refining the sample
pages.body:
The Essence Condenser uses one dormant flake and 4000 Resonance to produce one assimilation essence. Processing takes ten seconds when powered. The left slot holds the sample, the right the result. Hoppers can supply raw input and take completed essence.

The starter source consumes no ongoing fuel. Its Dormant Knot is part of the crafted instrument. Stored power and paid processing survive saves. A redstone signal pauses generator production.

pages.heading: A contained heartbeat
pages.body:
Recover a living assimilation heart on an expedition. Build a Living-heart Engine around that specimen and a resonator. The closed chamber can support a heartbeat even under the Stillness.

One refined essence sustains thirty seconds of running at eighty Resonance per tick. A full power bank pauses upkeep; an unfed engine goes dormant. Containment does not fail into an unannounced outbreak. Opening the world’s protection remains a separate deliberate act.

pages.heading: The severed current
pages.body:
A true liberation leaves a stable remnant. Craft an Unattuned Severance Core, then use it on a terminal in a dimension whose bound guardian has been defeated and whose expedition has extracted.

Install the attuned core in a Severance Cradle for 120 Resonance per tick without fuel or field crowding. The source remains tied to that dimension’s proven liberation. Routine completions or a wandering hunting echo cannot grant it.

The remnant can be carried home or into another frontier. Liberation now provides both an outpost and a practical power source.

pages.heading: Opening the field
pages.body:
Sneak-use an attunement sigil on a charged condenser to reverse the Stillness locally. Opening requires a 4000 Resonance reserve; sustaining it consumes twenty per tick. Refining pauses while open.

The breach reaches twenty-four blocks. A dormant resonator inside it loses the quiet field it draws from; use a contained heart engine, a severed core, or power supplied from outside.

Close the breach with the sigil or remove its power to restore protection. No source opens a breach automatically. Liberated ground stays silent.

terminal.title: IV. The threshold
terminal.unlock_hint: Use an expedition terminal. A deployed terminal is a promise that there is somewhere to come back to.

pages.heading: An address in the dark
pages.body:
The terminal does not make the frontier safe. It remembers an address.

Use it to select an expedition, difficulty and route length. Read the mission's requirements before deploying. Some need a sigil, previous expedition proof, tokens, or a more established campaign.

Starting resolves a safe route first. If none can be found, nothing is deployed.

pages.heading: Before you step through
pages.body:
The portal opens above the terminal. Enter it to deploy and receive a compass. Other players may join through it until the first checkpoint seals the party.

Take food, a weapon and room for recovered cargo. The terminal can offer loaded modded dimensions too; their own biome creatures may answer a checkpoint's call.

An absent dimension cannot host a route.

wayfinding.title: V. Heartwood
wayfinding.unlock_hint: Step through an expedition portal and let the terminal issue your compass.

pages.heading: Follow the thorn
pages.body:
The compass points to your next checkpoint, then extraction. It follows a route, not a lodestone.

Its hovering ember tells height: above the needle means the target is higher; below means it is lower. Near your elevation, it settles around the center.

Hold use to attune. The ember climbs or sinks and the chimes rise or fall. Release to quiet it.

pages.heading: Read the country
pages.body:
The compass gives a bearing, not a walkable path. Go around cliffs, find a stair through caves, and treat lava as lava.

Routes are checked against the destination's real terrain. A ceiling is not a surface to stand upon. Dimensions with unfamiliar terrain may still refuse a route safely.

The terminal recalls its compass when the expedition ends.

checkpoints.title: VI. Checkpoints
checkpoints.unlock_hint: Activate an expedition checkpoint. Merely walking past it does not settle the instrument.

pages.heading: Wake the instrument
pages.body:
Use each checkpoint in the order the compass gives. The first checkpoint seals the party.

A checkpoint banks part of the guaranteed token reward for every member. Those secured tokens survive failure. Completion settles what remains, including earned bonuses.

A horde may answer the activation. Expect creatures that belong to this dimension's biome, including unfamiliar ones.

pages.heading: What failure costs
pages.body:
Death removes a member from the expedition. The last member lost fails the run. You keep tokens already secured at checkpoints; unfinished bonuses remain at risk.

Disconnecting leaves the run resumable. On return, every marker and the dimension itself must still exist. Missing pieces fail the expedition safely.

Extraction, not the final checkpoint, ends the journey.

cargo.title: VII. Sealed cargo
cargo.unlock_hint: Reach a recovery objective and receive the expedition's physical artifact.

pages.heading: Something to bring home
pages.body:
The seal carries the same faint warmth as the journal clasp. Whatever was stored here was meant to travel.

A recovery mission issues its artifact at the named checkpoint. Keep it safe and hold it when using the extraction marker.

The seal belongs to this expedition. A souvenir from another run cannot satisfy it.

pages.heading: Proof has weight
pages.body:
A recovered artifact is a physical item. Losing it can leave a required recovery unfinished. Return and retrieve it before extracting.

At successful extraction, the bound cargo is consumed and its objective settles. The journal is a record; it does not stand in for the missing object.

The frontier has a habit of making paperwork literal.

defense.title: VIII. Hold the line
defense.unlock_hint: Deploy a defense device by reaching a checkpoint with a defend-device objective.

pages.heading: The machine draws breath
pages.body:
The extractor's first pulse travels farther than its light. Things in the dark hear it.

A defense objective raises a device beside its checkpoint. Protect it until the countdown finishes. Waves focus the machine; waiting at the next marker will not protect it.

Its remaining integrity matters. Player blows can damage it too.

pages.heading: Make a place to stand
pages.body:
Scout the approach before activation. Clear room to move, keep a way back to the device, and bring the equipment you need to interrupt attackers.

If a required device is destroyed, the expedition fails. An optional device can be lost without ending the route, but its bonus is gone.

A vanished device is treated as destroyed. The terminal never assumes an absent machine survived.

blood.title: IX. Blood assay
blood.unlock_hint: Experience Bloom exposure, or draw a sample with a field assay kit.

pages.heading: A sealed answer
pages.body:
The guide records what the Charter has learned. Blood belongs in the field assay kit.

Craft the kit with a glass bottle, iron ingot, copper ingot and assimilation essence. Sneak-use it to draw a nonlethal sample costing one heart.

Use normally to inspect the sealed sample: patient, infection percentage, stage and sample age. It is a measured snapshot; draw another sample to check your recovery.

pages.heading: Leave before it answers
pages.body:
Live hearts can build infection while you stay nearby. The effects intensify by stage; extreme exposure has consequences beyond a passing sickness.

Low exposure subsides away from the source. Check a fresh assay before another long harvest. Assimilation Disruption blocks new exposure. A Disruption Charm supplies it while held in the offhand or worn in a Curios charm slot; an existing dose still needs time to subside.

The kit remembers its sealed sample. The journal retains only your discoveries.

pressure.title: X. Awareness
pressure.unlock_hint: Endure an infected hunting party, or raise a dimension’s awareness to twenty-five.

pages.heading: An answering pulse
pages.body:
The forest stops pretending it has not seen you.

The sheltered Overworld has no natural Bloom attention. In an affected frontier dimension, the Bloom tracks your presence. A top-screen bar counts toward the next escalation: Listening, Noticed, Hunted, Overrun, then Reckoning. Hunters carry the infection; exposure still requires contact.

The default frontier grants two quiet minutes, sends hunters after four, intensifies at seven, and calls a pursuing guardian after ten effective minutes. Establishing a foothold halves its clock. A deliberately opened Overworld breach can also attract attention while you stand inside it. Some dimensions may be tuned differently.

A checkpoint removes 45 seconds of attention. Leaving or resting in the spawn refuge cools it twice as fast as it rises. Logging out or dying does not reset it. A disruption charm prevents new infection, not the hunt.

The survey’s dimensional pressure is a separate shared measure that strengthens expedition waves. The attention bar measures your personal exposure.

extraction.title: XI. Extraction
extraction.unlock_hint: Complete a run by using its extraction marker after satisfying every required objective.

pages.heading: Count everyone home
pages.body:
The terminal's light is a small thing to miss. It looks different when you have earned the return journey.

Use extraction after all checkpoints and required objectives are complete. Hold recovered cargo if the mission requires it. Completion returns the party home and settles rewards.

Optional objectives and fast completion may add bonuses. The mission description tells you the terms.

pages.heading: Build on what survived
pages.body:
Successful missions leave permanent proof and advance their dimension's campaign. That proof opens harder work at the terminal. A listed mission can remain locked until its other requirements are met.

Tokens buy rewards through /expeditions redeem. The reward pool follows the dimension you stand in.

The field guide remembers your discoveries after death. The frontier should leave you with more than scars.

guardian.title: XII. The guardian
guardian.unlock_hint: Deploy into Heart of the Thicket after completing Deep Salvage. Reach the final checkpoint to awaken what guards the roots.

pages.heading: The Rootbound Guardian
pages.body:
The crown is not growing from its head. The head is growing around the crown.

At the final checkpoint of Heart of the Thicket, a guardian takes shape. Defeat it, then use extraction to settle the campaign victory. Reaching the exit while it lives will not clear the dimension.

The approach costs 25 tokens and requires Deep Salvage proof and an established campaign.

pages.heading: Read the ember circle
pages.body:
When the guardian roots itself and raises its arms, an ember circle marks its sweep. Leave the circle before the strike. Its exposed core takes extra damage during the windup: a chance to press your attack if you can still escape.

Below half health, its core flares. It alternates sweeps with smaller bursts marked beneath its target. Keep moving out of each new mark.

Every strike has a warning and recovery. It does not tear up the terrain.

liberation.title: XIII. After silence
liberation.unlock_hint: Stand in a dimension whose major threat has been defeated and whose campaign has been cleared.

pages.heading: A quieter country
pages.body:
The roots remain. Their orders do not.

Routine expeditions establish a foothold after two completions. The terminal then offers that dimension’s Sever the Bloom mission, or its authored confrontation. Defeat the mission’s bound guardian and extract to liberate the dimension for everyone. Routine completions alone cannot replace that proof.

Liberation silences ambient heart seeding, growth and infection there; the attention bar and pursuit hunts end. Dormant growth remains as a scar. Ordinary native monsters and vanilla hazards still exist.

Completing the first Field Survey opens remote terminal deployments. The Stillness already shelters home; its optional confrontations do not gate the frontier. Native portals remain usable earlier, if you accept the danger. A guardian sent by the hunt is only an echo: killing it does not sever the dimension.

pages.heading: Power after silence
pages.body:
Guardian victory and successful extraction leave more than quiet ground. Craft an Unattuned Severance Core and attune it at a terminal here. A Severance Cradle can then draw stable power from the remnant anywhere.

This proof is shared with the world and persists with the campaign. A count-only cleared mark is not an accepted guardian victory. Existing genuine boss trophies can recover old proof. Resetting a source dimension pauses its cores until liberation is restored.

preparation.title: XIV. What we bring back
preparation.unlock_hint: Recover an assimilation heart, or obtain a Heartglass Lens or Field Ward.

pages.heading: The return matters
pages.body:
Essence is a workshop material, not the only reason to cross the threshold. A recovered living heart can become a contained engine, a Heartglass Lens, or a Field Ward. Each consumes the specimen during crafting. Choose which capability your next journey needs.

Tokens banked at checkpoints buy supplies or fund later deployments. Successful home training follows Survey, Trace Recovery, Deep Salvage and the guardian. Other dimensions establish footholds before their liberation mission.

pages.heading: Carry the current
pages.body:
Craft a Resonance Cell from a dormant knot, two essence, copper and iron. It holds 16000 Resonance and starts empty. Sneak-use a generator to draw power; use a compatible receiver to supply it. Hold use for repeated transfers. Standard FE item chargers can fill it too.

The cell keeps its charge when carried home, dropped or saved. Spend home power on your next journey instead of building a generator at every stop.

pages.heading: A moment to regroup
pages.body:
Craft a Field Ward around a recovered heart. Place it, then use a cell containing at least 4000 Resonance to light it. For two minutes, Bloom attention holds steady and personal dwell pressure pauses within eight blocks. One cell holds four charges.

The field does not lower existing attention, stop an existing hunt, prevent infection or block ordinary enemies. Overlapping wards do not multiply the benefit. Check the ward with an empty hand. You can recover the instrument, but breaking it loses its remaining charge. Its paid deadline keeps running while the chunk is unloaded.

pages.heading: Measure the dark
pages.body:
A Heartglass Lens uses a recovered heart, essence, copper and amethyst. Carry it with a charged cell while using the issued compass. Finish a reading to spend 200 Resonance and see horizontal distance and signed height to the next checkpoint or extraction.

The original needle and elevation ember remain useful without either upgrade. A lens gives a measurement, not a path through walls. It is kept after extraction; the terminal only recalls its issued compass.
